messages:
Jin (Sales): FYI passing Sunburst to CS — signed last week. Committed to Dedicated (3 GPUs). They need SSO + SOC2 data flow clarity and a staging acceptance test. Primary contact: laura@sunburst.io. Currently only sandbox usage, no prod traffic yet. Renewal window ~11 months.

Maya (CS): thanks Jin. Can you confirm legal/finance status and whether they require a specific region? also any timeline expectations from the customer?

Jin (Sales): Legal signed our standard SOW; finance has A/R in motion. They asked for VPC in us-east-1 and an on-prem-like staging environment for acceptance testing. They want kickoff early next week.

Maya (CS): noted. @Priya (Eng) / @Ravi (Support) — we need three things before kickoff: 1) private deploy + staging cost/ETA, 2) SSO (SAML) connector checklist and test plan, 3) onboarding/runbook + support escalation path. Who can own which?

Ravi (Support): I can own SSO test plan and the support runbook. I'll need SAML metadata and expected auth flows from them. Also want a short checklist from Eng for firewall/KMS requirements.

Priya (Eng): I will scope provisioning for the dedicated pool and staging. Quick Q: do they require HSM now or just KMS for key management? Jin?

Jin (Sales): KMS for initial rollout; HSM is a possible follow-up but not in initial SOW.

Maya (CS): action owners and dates: Jin — intro to Laura + share contract/PIA and SAML contact (due EOD tomorrow). Priya — provisioning estimate + staging cost (due Thu). Ravi — SSO test plan + support runbook (due Thu). I'll schedule kickoff Tue 10am PT and create the weekly onboarding sync.

Ravi (Support): Ack. I'll draft SSO test cases (happy path, expired cert, metadata rotate) and runbook steps. Recommend we include fallback to hosted API in case private staging has an outage.

Priya (Eng): preliminary estimates: ~2 dev-days to provision infra, ~4 days for validation and runbook. Provisional staging cost: ~$2.6k/month (rough; will refine). I'll also document required ports, KMS key ARN pattern, and model pinning guidance for Dedicated.

Jin (Sales): Sharing contact now: laura@sunburst.io. She prefers mornings. cc'ing Legal/Finance in the email.

Maya (CS): risk note for renewals: currently low, but becomes medium if adoption hasn't started within 60 days post-kickoff. Proposed adoption milestones: P0 — staging acceptance within 30d, P1 — 100 prod calls within 90d. We'll track these in the onboarding folder.

Ravi (Support): escalation plan: priority email + on-call pager during staging and first 2 weeks of prod. I'll add a step-by-step for incident triage and contact matrix in the runbook.

Priya (Eng): also will include recommended quantization/profile and model pinning to ensure consistent latency on Dedicated. Sharing config snippet in the runbook before kickoff.

Maya (CS): I'll create the shared folder with runbooks, test plans, and a short 1-pager for the customer. Kickoff invite once Jin sends the intro.

Jin (Sales): thanks all — marking handoff complete from sales side. @Maya I loop Laura into the kickoff invite now.

DeployBot: calendar event created: Sunburst kickoff Tue 10:00 AM PT (invites sent).
